tweets.text:
Antonio Paz fraudulently obtained citizenship by lying on immigration forms. Let’s dust off his case file to learn more about how denaturalization happens.

After obtaining citizenship, Paz pleaded guilty to committing six counts of felony embezzlement before he was naturalized.

He confessed to stealing over $75,000 from senior citizens at a retirement community — while he was employed as its director — prior to applying for citizenship.

He was convicted of immigration fraud and his citizenship was revoked.
 
💻Related court records are available on PACER under case no. 5:20-cr-00299-1D(3).
